title: Bashar: Shifting Through Parallel Realities
author: Free Vibrations
opening_summary: Bashar explains that in each moment, consciousness exists in a completely different parallel reality. One's self-definition in the next moment determines what reality one inhabits and what that reality becomes. Consistency of self-definition creates the illusion that change takes time. However, by genuinely redefining oneself and behaving as if transformation is complete, one becomes a different person in a different reality with altered DNA, experience, and history. This teaching emphasizes the power of conscious self-redefinition across parallel realities.

quotes.quote: Each and every moment you actually exist in a completely different parallel reality.
What you define yourself to be determines what you are in that parallel reality.
Your consistency of self-definition makes it seem as if changes take time.
If you really learn to redefine yourself and behave like you have done it, you will be a different person in a different reality.
